reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM products
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(category_raw)) = 'tv/video'
alternatives: SELECT product_id, product_name FROM products WHERE TRIM(category_raw) ILIKE 'tv/video'
SELECT product_id, product_name FROM products WHERE TRIM(LOWER(category_raw)) = 'tv/video'

other_way.sql: SELECT product_id, product_name FROM products WHERE TRIM(category_raw) ILIKE 'tv/video'
other_way.tradeoff: ILIKE ignores letter case in one step, while LOWER makes the cleaning visible and works the same in a join.
